appPairing.approved.note: You can close this page and go back to {name}. It is listed with your credentials, where you can disconnect it at any time.

appPairing.can.read: It will be able to see your printers, prints, files and history. It cannot change anything.
appPairing.code.note: The code the app shows, such as BCDF-GHJK.

appPairing.denied.title: {name} is not connected
appPairing.empty.heading: Type the code the app shows

appPairing.title: Pair an app
